blocks.text: Truth tables logic mein statements ki truth values (sach ya jhoot) dikhane ke liye istemal hote hain. Yeh samjhate hain ke logical expressions kaise kaam karte hain. Truth table truth values ke tamam mumkin combinations (jor) likhta hai aur har combination ka aakhri nateeja dikhata hai. Propositional logic mein truth tables aham hain aur computer science aur maths mein aam istemal hote hain. Yeh logical expressions ki durusti check karne mein madad dete hain aur logical soch ko saaf aur aasan banate hain (Figure 2.5 dekhein).

blocks.caption: Figure 2.5: Logical expressions ka truth table

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table ko line ba line parhein. A AND B sirf pehli line mein True hai, jahan A aur B dono True hain. A OR B sirf aakhri line mein False hai, jahan dono False hain. NOT A hamesha A ka ulat hai.
